records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Media
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Orchard Media* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with zero customer replies to three outbound emails (email:56f1ec46, email:7ebc4ad6, email:c7f88cc7), no tickets, no project, no invites. No signal of intent or engagement, so unaided activation in 8 days is unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on my note from yesterday — no pressure, just want to make sure nothing's blocking you.

If it's helpful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Once that's in place, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything about how your team would use Wrenfield.

Best,
Chidi
